nodes.label: TandemPay Android Monochrome App Icon (Chevron/Caret Symbol)
nodes.description: Monochrome Android adaptive icon for TandemPay. Depicts a bold upward-pointing chevron (caret/lambda shape) in medium grey on a white background. The symbol is thick-stroked with rounded ends, resembling the letter A or an upward arrow chevron — likely representing the TandemPay brand mark. Used as the monochrome layer for Android 13+ themed/adaptive icons.
